question: Tropical cyclones originate over which of the following regions?

options.text: Mediterranean Sea, Arabian Sea and the Indian Ocean
Mediterranean Sea, Pacific Ocean and the Indian Ocean
Bay of Bengal, Arabian Sea and the Atlantic Ocean
Bay of Bengal, Arabian Sea and the Indian Ocean

solution:
The correct answer is __**Bay of Bengal, Arabian Sea and the Indian Ocean **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tropical cyclone**s predominantly originate over warm oceanic waters in the Bay of Bengal, Arabian Sea, and the Indian Ocea**n, especially when sea surface temperatures exceed a certain threshold, typically around 26.5°C.
 
• It **also known as hurricanes or typhoons depending on the region, originate over warm ocean waters in specifi**c conditions
 
• **Tropical cyclones originate o**ver warm ocean basins in the lower latitudes of all oceans except the south Atlantic and southeast Pacific.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bay of Bengal**:

 
 
• One of the most active regions for tropical cyclones due to its warm sea surface temperatures, high humidity, and favorable atmospheric conditions.
 
• Cyclones like **Cyclone Amphan**, **Fani**, and **Yas** originate here.
 
 
 
• **Arabian Sea**:
 
 
• Also a significant region for tropical cyclones, though relatively less active compared to the Bay of Bengal.
 
• Notable cyclones like **Ockhi** and **Mekunu** originate here.
 
 
 
• **Indian Ocean**:
 
 
• Includes both the Arabian Sea and the Bay of Bengal. It serves as a primary breeding ground for cyclones that later affect India, Sri Lanka, the Maldives, and other surrounding regions.
